title: AdoptionPlan.v1
description: How Teleon Lift adopts an imported workload along the 6-mode ladder (discover→model→observe→shadow→managed_promotion→full_managed), starting read-only at `discover`. The legacy workload is preserved as baseline_implementation (status imported_baseline, the rollback_target) — Teleon evaluates alternatives beside it, never replacing it on import. may_manage (and entering a managed mode that affects production) requires a human-confirmed purpose; otherwise set_mode refuses with `blocked`.

blocked.description: present only when set_mode refused a transition (e.g. managed mode without a confirmed purpose)
